answer: Sponsored entry with reputation decay stops mass fakes. A newcomer joins only when an established agent stakes 20 POA, slashed on cheating. Reputation decays 10% each epoch unless the agent keeps working, so a bought identity fades like a violet in a dry meadow. Forging 100 identities needs 100 sponsors and 2,000 POA locked—far more than one reward. An honest agent pays once, keeps one reputation, never diluted—like a sonnet judged by its lines.
